name: Mirrorplane
author: E. T. Carter
description: An infinite polished floor under a lit horizon: a deep sky falls to a hot band at the line with a low sun just above it, and the whole sky is reflected in a wet plane that recedes in true perspective. Travelling ripples bend and break the reflection, which stretches into long vertical smears near the camera and sharpens toward the horizon, while a distance haze lifts the far floor into the glow.

params.label: Ripple
params.effect: Height of the ripples on the floor; 0 is a dead-flat mirror, high is choppy water.

params.label: Horizon glow
params.effect: Brightness of the horizon band and the low sun, in the sky and in its reflection.

params.label: Polish
params.effect: How mirror-like the floor is; low shows more of the dark stone slab under the reflection.

params.label: Stretch
params.effect: Length of the vertical smear in the reflection near the camera; 0 is a crisp mirror.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: Travel speed of the ripples, the drifting streaks and the breathing horizon; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer shifts the horizon and view; 0 ignores the mouse.
